dan: Heads up - planned power-handshake maintenance on EU rack P2 (colocation vendor) Tue 2026-04-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll do staged PDU cycles; likely transient NIC flaps and host reboots. Aim is no customer-visible downtime but expect retries. Need ops runbook, LM checks, and customer comms.

eva: Ack. Which subpools affected? Any Dedicated pools pinned?

dan: Impact: eu-west3-gpu-pool-b. Dedicated tenant on these hosts: tenant-dedicated-7. Plan: attempt live-migrate containers to warm standbys; fallback is fail-over to reserve capacity.

mike: Running live-migrate probe: `./tools/check-lm.sh eu-west3-gpu-pool-b` now.

sophie: If cross-region burst to us-east required, cost hit ~+20-30% for window. @natalie please confirm budget buffer :money_with_wings:

alex: Ops proposal snippet:
- mark hosts maintenance: `rctl maintenance set --hosts host-01..host-08 --reason "PDU power handshake"`
- pre-warm spares: `infractl node spinup --region eu-west2 --count 4`
- LM probe: `./tools/check-lm.sh eu-west3-gpu-pool-b` || graceful-drain host
- staged power cycles: loop hosts with 10m gap and 120s drain grace
- monitor: per-route latency & errors, escalate if 5xx >2x baseline

maintenance-bot: Ticket INFRA-1298 created; maintenance scheduled in ops planner.

dan: Action items: eva: host->tenant mapping; mike: LM output by EOD; alex: coordinate spares + autoscale; natalie: confirm budget; I'll draft Dedicated customer note. Ping sre-oncall on sustained 5xx or resets. :thumbsup: 

eva: Posting host->tenant map and opt-outs.

mike: LM probe output: 3/4 hosts passed. host-042 failed (driver/kernel). Exclude host-042 from automation; manual patch after maintenance.

dan: Excluding host-042 from automation. I'll post customer note in #customer-success in 30m.
